items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. Compliance is technical-only at 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; no certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, which does not establish complete TLS safety. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases; allow only reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior; continue the existing read-only evidence matrix without duplicate telemetry, credential access, private-container access, permission changes, deployment, exploitation, or outreach.
